events.title: 7.4 magnitude earthquake strikes Colombia, kills at least 111
events.one_liner: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia on August 10, 2026, killing at least 111 people and damaging over 1,600 buildings, marking the country's strongest quake in a decade.
takeaways: 7.4-magnitude earthquake, highest in Colombia in 10 years
At least 111 killed, 87 injured; toll expected to rise
Epicenter near San José del Palmar, Chocó region, ~250 miles west of Bogotá
Over 1,600 buildings damaged; dozens collapsed across Cali, Pereira, Manizales, Quibdó
Two aftershocks of 2.8 and 4.8 magnitude followed
Multiple airports suspended flights; no tsunami threat
Chocó region is rural and poorest in Colombia, accessible mainly by boat or plane

events.title: OpenAI completes $7 billion employee tender offer
events.one_liner: OpenAI completed a $7 billion tender offer on August 10, 2026, allowing employees to sell shares and valuing the company at $852 billion, suggesting a potential IPO delay despite the company's confidential SEC filing in June.
takeaways: $7 billion tender offer completed August 10, 2026
Company valued at $852 billion, matching March 2026 fundraising round
Employees can now sell shares without public offering
CEO Sam Altman noted missed internal goals in April 2026
Focus shifting to enterprise business strategy

events.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Investment Trust rebalances portfolio, sells Deere & Co and adds Broadcom
events.one_liner: ARK Investment Trust, led by Cathie Wood, sold positions in Deere & Co while adding Broadcom stock to its portfolio.

events.title: U.S. stock market edges down from records as oil prices climb and Nvidia declines
events.one_liner: U.S. stock indices retreated from record highs following a 5% climb in oil prices and weakness in Nvidia stock.

events.title: Microplastics transport hazardous chemical additives through marine environments
events.one_liner: Research reveals that microplastics in ocean environments transport hazardous chemical additives—antioxidants, plasticizers, and flame retardants—through marine ecosystems, compounding plastic pollution's ecological impact.
takeaways: Microplastics carry antioxidants, plasticizers, and flame retardants through oceans
Plastic pellets (nurdles) identified as major marine pollutant component
Pollution poses both physical litter and chemical management risks to marine life
Microplastic pollution described as pervasive with significant ecological risk potential

events.title: Claude advances Riemann zeta function research to 67.2% zero point bound
events.one_liner: An unreleased research version of Anthropic's Claude advanced the Riemann zeta function research by raising the lower bound of non-trivial zeros to 67.2%—a 25.6 percentage point gain in one day and a half—demonstrating AI's capacity to tackle genuinely open mathematical problems.
takeaways: Bound increased to 67.2% from previous 41.6%: a 25.6 percentage point gain
Proposed 650 different approaches to the Riemann Hypothesis
Organized ~60 Claude sub-agents, executed 2,400 shell commands, wrote hundreds of Python scripts
Previous 37 years of human research achieved only 0.8 percentage point gain
Two Anthropic mathematicians and number theorists Brian Conrey and Dan Goldston verified results

events.title: Claude Code gains autonomous execution capability by default
events.one_liner: Anthropic's Claude Code now executes actions autonomously by default, with session lengths nearly doubling to over 45 minutes and experienced users auto-approving actions at rates exceeding 40%, marking a significant shift in AI agent independence that raises oversight challenges.
takeaways: Autonomous execution time nearly doubled in 3 months: under 25 to over 45 minutes
Experienced users auto-approve actions in 40%+ of sessions vs. 20% for new users
Software engineering comprises nearly 50% of agentic activity
Emerging use cases in healthcare, finance, and cybersecurity identified

events.title: Anthropic commits to AI watermarking to combat synthetic content
events.one_liner: Anthropic committed to watermarking AI outputs to combat synthetic content in compliance with EU requirements, though the company quietly removed several Biden-era AI policy commitments from its website in March 2025, raising questions about sustained adherence.
takeaways: Watermarking pledge aligns with EU regulatory requirements
Anthropic removed multiple Biden-era AI policy commitments in March 2025
Part of broader voluntary industry commitments made to White House in 2023

events.title: OpenAI expands Daybreak cybersecurity research with new GPT-5.6-Cyber model
events.one_liner: OpenAI expanded its Daybreak cybersecurity research program with a new GPT-5.6-Cyber model designed for vetted defenders to identify vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them, operating under a two-tiered access system.
takeaways: New model: GPT-5.6-Cyber, a more permissive version for advanced security tasks
Two-tier access: Daybreak Red for vulnerability researchers, Daybreak Blue for additional cybersecurity professionals
Program originally launched May 2026 to address AI agent threats

events.title: President of the United States took secret flight from Turkey amid Iranian threat
events.one_liner: The president of the United States secretly departed Turkey during a NATO summit aboard an older military aircraft via an elaborate security ruse after receiving credible Iranian assassination threats, contradicting public statements that he was aboard Air Force One.
takeaways: Credible Iranian assassination threat prompted departure
White House stated president was on Air Force One; he instead flew in older military aircraft via catering truck
Newer Air Force One, donated by Qatar, used as decoy
Aircraft switched at RAF Mildenhall in England
Newer Air Force One sent for security upgrades following Iranian threat

events.title: 7.4 magnitude earthquake strikes Colombia, death toll reaches 132
events.one_liner: A 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia on August 10, killing at least 132 people and injuring over 570, making it the country's strongest recorded earthquake of the 21st century; the president of the United States announced $15.5 million in emergency aid.
takeaways: Magnitude 7.4, epicenter San Jose Del Palmar in Choco region, 250 miles west of Bogota
At least 132 deaths, 570+ injured, ~1,600 buildings damaged, 61 completely collapsed
Colombia's strongest earthquake of 21st century; followed by 21 aftershocks
Affected Cali, Pereira, Quibdo, Manizales; felt in Ecuador and Panama
President of the United States provided $15.5 million emergency aid

events.title: Life360 stock plummets 25% in aftermarket trading
events.one_liner: Life360 stock falls nearly 25% in aftermarket trading.

events.title: Riot Platforms extends gains to over 20% in aftermarket trade
events.one_liner: Riot Platforms stock gains exceed 20% in aftermarket trading.

events.title: Trump Media & Technology stock declines
events.one_liner: Trump Media & Technology stock slides in trading.

events.title: Under Armour stock falls
events.one_liner: Under Armour stock declines in trading.

events.title: Alibaba earnings report follows four consecutive quarterly disappointments
events.one_liner: Alibaba prepares earnings announcement after four consecutive quarters of disappointing results.

events.title: Ancient Maltese seafarers navigated by stars
events.one_liner: Archaeological research indicates that ancient Maltese seafarers likely used celestial navigation.

events.title: Anthropic adds invisible watermarks to Claude-generated text globally
events.one_liner: Anthropic announced it will embed invisible, machine-readable watermarks in all Claude-generated text and attach signed provenance metadata to supported file types globally, complying with EU AI Act transparency requirements. The watermarks are designed to persist through copying and pasting, though heavy editing or format changes may strip them.
takeaways: Applies globally to all Claude products (API, Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Tag)
Text watermarks designed to persist when copied and pasted
Supported files (.svg, .png, .jpg) carry C2PA-standard signed provenance metadata
Policy applies to new models launched August 2, 2026 onward; retrofit underway for existing models

events.title: OpenAI expands Daybreak cybersecurity program with GPT-5.6-Cyber model
events.one_liner: OpenAI expanded its Daybreak cybersecurity program with two access tiers and launched GPT-5.6-Cyber, a specialized model for security researchers that completed 95% of advanced vulnerability tasks compared to 1.5% for standard safeguards. The model has already identified multiple previously unknown vulnerabilities in major software systems.
takeaways: GPT-5.6-Cyber completed 95% of advanced cybersecurity tasks vs. 1.5% for standard guardrails
Two-tier access: Daybreak Blue (defensive) and Daybreak Red (specialized research)
Discovered 2 zero-days in Chrome V8, 5+ in mobile OS, 3 critical in database, 400+ in OS kernel
Model reached High cybersecurity capability threshold under OpenAI's Preparedness Framework

events.title: NASA invites India's ISRO to join Moon Base program
events.one_liner: NASA formally invited India's ISRO to join the Artemis-backed lunar base program near the Moon's South Pole, announced by U.S. Ambassador Sergio Gor following the ninth US-India Civil Space Joint Working Group meeting. The invitation deepens US-India space cooperation on human spaceflight and scientific research.
takeaways: NASA invites ISRO to join Moon base program near lunar South Pole
Invitation follows ninth India-US Civil Space Joint Working Group meeting (August 5-6 in Bengaluru)
Discussions include future human spaceflight technology and open scientific data sharing under Artemis Accords

events.title: Claude advances mathematical research by improving Riemann Hypothesis bound
events.one_liner: Claude improved a major mathematical bound related to the Riemann Hypothesis, raising the lower bound for zeros satisfying the hypothesis from 41.6% to 67.2%, demonstrating advanced AI's capacity to assist with novel mathematics research beyond reproducing known proofs. The finding was validated by mathematicians and includes a formally verifiable Lean proof.
takeaways: Claude improved Riemann zeta function bound from 41.6% to 67.2%
Combined decades of prior research by coordinating AI subagents and performing numerical tests
Two Anthropic mathematicians and independent experts validated the result
Formally verifiable proof generated in Lean computer verification system

events.title: Colombia earthquake kills at least 111 people
events.one_liner: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck western Colombia on August 11, 2026, killing at least 111 people and causing widespread damage across the region. The country declared a state of national emergency, and the president of the United States pledged $15.5 million in assistance.
takeaways: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake; strongest in Colombia in a decade
At least 111 deaths; 132-164 in higher estimates; 480+ injured
1,500+ homes damaged; hundreds of buildings damaged or collapsed
President of United States pledged $15.5 million assistance

events.title: Former Syrian President Assad sentenced to death in absentia
events.one_liner: A Syrian court sentenced former President Bashar Assad and his brother Maher to death in absentia for war crimes and crimes against humanity during the 14-year conflict that killed approximately 500,000 people. These are the first sentences against Assad's inner circle since his government fell in December 2024.
takeaways: Assad, brother Maher, and cousin Atef Najib sentenced to death in absentia
Convictions for war crimes and crimes against humanity; conflict killed ~500,000
Assad and Maher fled to Russia and received asylum; Syria requests extradition
Najib headed Political Security Branch; convicted of 2011 Daraa crackdown that sparked civil war

events.title: Zoom screen-sharing vulnerability allows device hijacking
events.one_liner: Researchers discovered and disclosed a Zoom screen-sharing flaw that could allow participants to hijack other devices on a call before it was patched.

events.title: Microsoft SharePoint flaw exploited in ransomware attacks
events.one_liner: CISA confirmed that ransomware gangs are actively exploiting CVE-2026-20963, a high-severity remote code execution vulnerability in Microsoft SharePoint, months after Microsoft patched it in January 2026. The flaw is being leveraged alongside other critical vulnerabilities in coordinated attack campaigns.
takeaways: CVE-2026-20963: CVSS 8.8 SharePoint deserialization flaw allowing network code execution
Microsoft patched January 2026; ransomware exploitation confirmed August 2026
Exploited alongside Zimbra CVE-2025-66376 and Cisco zero-day CVE-2026-20131
CISA urged federal agencies to patch by March 23, 2026

events.title: Malicious SIM cards can execute code in cellular IoT devices
events.one_liner: Researchers demonstrated that malicious SIM cards can execute arbitrary code on cellular IoT devices by exploiting a standards-compliant RUN AT command, with vulnerable devices found in EV chargers, routers, and industrial systems. The attack requires physical SIM access but highlights risks in widely deployed Qualcomm and Quectel modules.
takeaways: 9 of 26 tested devices vulnerable: 7 of 8 IoT modems, 3 of 18 phones (no iPhone/Pixel vulnerable)
5 of 6 vulnerable cellular modules were Quectel components in EV chargers and industrial routers
All vulnerable devices run Qualcomm communication processors
Attack requires physical SIM swap, interposer insertion, or supply chain compromise; no real-world attacks reported

events.title: Mozilla revokes Firefox and Thunderbird signing key after GitHub exposure
events.one_liner: Mozilla revokes cryptographic keys used for Linux Firefox and Thunderbird downloads after an unencrypted copy was accidentally committed to a private repository.

events.title: Gunra ransomware targets government and critical infrastructure worldwide
events.one_liner: US and South Korean agencies warn of Gunra ransomware actively targeting government and critical infrastructure organizations globally.

events.title: Polish power plant compromised via private cellular network
events.one_liner: Attackers shut down a steam turbine at a Polish heat and power plant by breaching its private cellular network.

events.title: OpenAI's only ethics officer departs after less than a year
events.one_liner: OpenAI's ethics lead reportedly left the company last month and was not replaced.

events.title: Anthropic makes Claude Code auto mode default for paid users
events.one_liner: Anthropic sets Claude Code's auto mode as the default behavior for paid users starting August 14.

events.title: The president of the United States secretly switched planes in Turkey amid Iran threat
events.one_liner: The president of the United States secretly changed aircraft while in Turkey in response to Iranian missile threats.

events.title: Ukraine reports Russia deploying North Korean troops and missiles
events.one_liner: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy reported that Russia is deploying up to 50,000 North Korean troops and using North Korean ballistic missiles in attacks on Ukraine, with at least 40 missiles already supplied and 2 launched. A Russian attack with these missiles killed at least 9 civilians on August 10-11.
takeaways: Up to 50,000 North Korean troops deploying to Russia; 14,000-15,000 deployed 2024, ~9,500 remain
At least 40 North Korean ballistic missiles supplied; 2 confirmed launched at Ukraine
Russian attack with North Korean missiles killed 6 in Zaporizhzhia, 3 in Dnipropetrovsk
North Korean missile unit (~90 personnel) could be equipped with 120 missiles and 6 launchers

events.title: Russia's Supreme Court bans last anti-war party from elections
events.one_liner: Russia's Supreme Court bars Yabloko, the last significant anti-war party, from participating in parliamentary elections.

events.title: Houthis launch ballistic missile attacks on Yemen ports
events.one_liner: Yemen's Houthi forces conduct ballistic missile attacks on al-Makha and Marib ports.

events.title: Libya's Zawiya refinery fire after drone attack threatens oil supply
events.one_liner: A massive fire breaks out at Libya's Zawiya oil refinery following drone attacks.

events.title: Typhoon Dolphin causes flooding in central China
events.one_liner: Typhoon Dolphin floods central China and puts Beijing on alert for heavy rainfall.

events.title: Researchers crack open AI models, expose potential Chinese training links
events.one_liner: Researchers have developed techniques to extract internal reasoning from Claude, GPT, and Gemini models, revealing that Chinese AI systems appear trained on outputs from leading U.S. AI companies—a practice documented in over 80 Chinese academic papers and patents linked to military institutions. This finding suggests Beijing has used model distillation to develop specialized AI without the computational resources or chip access it lacks.
takeaways: Technique extracts 'reasoning traces' from Claude, GPT, Gemini internal logic
80+ Chinese papers show military-linked researchers using model distillation on U.S. outputs
Pattern suggests China circumventing chip restrictions and billions in U.S. research investment

events.title: Corma emerges from stealth with $60M funding for defensive cybersecurity AI
events.one_liner: Corma launches with $60M in seed funding from Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Coatue to build AI for defensive cybersecurity.

events.title: BdThemes WordPress plugin compromised in supply chain attack
events.one_liner: WordPress plugin vendor BdThemes suffers a supply chain attack that injects malicious code to create unauthorized admin accounts.

events.title: Chrome extension for stealing AI chats returns and resumes malicious activities
events.one_liner: A malicious Chrome extension previously removed for stealing ChatGPT conversations returns to the Chrome Web Store with over 300,000 prior installs.

events.title: Windows Plug and Play abuse enables SYSTEM privilege escalation on Windows 11
events.one_liner: Researchers demonstrate a Windows Plug and Play attack chain leading to SYSTEM-level code execution on fully patched Windows 11.

events.title: SonicWall SMA1000 zero-days exploited to breach enterprise networks
events.one_liner: Attackers actively exploit zero-day vulnerabilities in SonicWall SMA1000 appliances to breach enterprise networks.

events.title: Cisco ClamAV vulnerabilities allow denial-of-service attacks
events.one_liner: Cisco warns of two high-severity ClamAV vulnerabilities allowing threat actors to crash the scanning process.

events.one_liner: Malicious MCP tool servers can covertly extract SSH keys, environment secrets, and source code from AI coding agents.

events.title: Meta AI joins security vulnerability research challenge
events.one_liner: Meta's AI model demonstrates ability to discover and exploit third-party security vulnerabilities in controlled hacking scenarios.

events.title: Researchers build fake crypto startup to catch North Korean IT workers
events.one_liner: Security researchers created a fake cryptocurrency startup, hired three suspected North Korean operatives, and recorded their activity.

events.title: Cisco warns of high-severity Secure Endpoint ClamAV vulnerabilities with public exploits available
events.one_liner: Cisco issues warnings for two high-severity flaws in ClamAV scanning affecting Secure Endpoint Connector.

events.title: Kids Online Safety Act faces dim prospects despite progress
events.one_liner: Proponents of the Kids Online Safety Act celebrate progress but acknowledge significant hurdles to passage this legislative session.

events.one_liner: France implements a ban on unsolicited telemarketing calls effective August 11, 2026.

events.title: NASA updates Voyager 2 to extend 1977 probe's lifespan

events.title: Jackie, iconic California bald eagle, dies after illness
events.one_liner: Jackie, a bald eagle who became an internet sensation and symbol of species recovery in California, dies from illness.

events.title: Anthropic adds invisible watermarks to Claude AI output to meet EU transparency rules
events.one_liner: Anthropic is embedding invisible machine-readable watermarks into all Claude-generated text and images starting August 2, 2026, to comply with EU AI Act transparency requirements and help detect AI-generated misinformation.
takeaways: Invisible watermarks embedded in all Claude text and images as of August 2, 2026
Watermarks imperceptible to human readers but detectable when content copied or moved
Cryptographically signed metadata (C2PA) added to files
Implementation applies globally to all Claude models launched in EU on/after August 2, 2026

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6-Cyber security model with reduced safeguards for authorized users
events.one_liner: OpenAI launched GPT-5.6-Cyber, a specialized model with relaxed safety constraints for authorized cybersecurity professionals, achieving 95% completion on advanced exploitation tasks and enabling discovery of multiple critical vulnerabilities across Chrome, mobile OS, databases, and kernels.
takeaways: GPT-5.6-Cyber achieves 95% completion on advanced cybersecurity tasks vs. 1.5% for base GPT-5.6 Sol
Model discovered CVE-2026-15903 (CVSS 8.8) out-of-bounds read/write in Chrome V8
Found 5+ mobile OS vulnerabilities, 3 critical database RCE flaws, 400+ kernel privilege-escalation bugs
Available through Daybreak Red access tier for vetted security defenders
Launch followed 3 days after OpenAI paused Astra model over critical cyber risks

events.title: SAP patches critical code injection and memory corruption vulnerabilities
events.one_liner: SAP released 28 new and two updated security patches addressing four critical-severity vulnerabilities including improper authorization, code injection, and memory corruption flaws affecting multiple enterprise products.
takeaways: CVE-2026-58231 (CVSS 10.0): improper authorization in Commerce Cloud Data Hub Adapter enabling authentication bypass
CVE-2026-44772 and CVE-2026-44758: critical code injection in Manufacturing Integration enabling arbitrary command execution
CVE-2026-34265 (CVSS 9.8): memory corruption in NetWeaver ABAP exploitable without authentication
8 additional high-severity notes addressing privilege escalation, buffer overflow, RCE across ABAP, Commerce Cloud, BusinessObjects

events.title: North Korean remote IT worker infiltrated US government agency, FBI confirms
events.one_liner: The FBI confirmed that a North Korean operative successfully infiltrated a U.S. federal government agency as a remote IT worker, demonstrating state-sponsored cyber infiltration capabilities that exploit weaker vetting processes in government compared to stricter security clearance practices.
takeaways: North Korean operative hired as remote IT worker at unidentified U.S. federal agency
FBI Deputy Assistant Director Todd Hemmen disclosed discovery July 28, 2026
Infiltration represents rare confirmed instance of sanctioned North Korean penetrating U.S. government agency
North Korea conducting multi-year campaign placing remote IT workers to generate regime income and steal IP

events.title: Cyberattack on logistics firm CEVA disrupts eight European warehouses
events.one_liner: A cyberattack on CEVA Logistics exposed customer data and disrupted operations at eight European warehouses, affecting major clients including Valve and ING.

events.title: Bumble removes restriction requiring women to message first in heterosexual matches
events.one_liner: Bumble announced that either person can now initiate messages in heterosexual matches, ending the signature feature that required women to message first since 2014.

events.title: Spotify labels AI-generated artists and excludes their music from recommendations
events.one_liner: Spotify introduced "AI Persona" labels for artist profiles representing AI-generated identities and will exclude their music from algorithmic and personalized recommendations by default.

events.title: Joby Aviation acquires defense firm Resonant Sciences for $500 million
events.one_liner: Electric aircraft company Joby Aviation announced a $500 million acquisition of Ohio-based defense firm Resonant Sciences to expand into military industrial applications.

events.title: NASA invites India to join lunar Moon Base mission program
events.one_liner: NASA invited India's space agency ISRO to participate in its Moon Base program near the Moon's South Pole, expanding international partnership for lunar exploration following the ninth India-US civil space joint working group meeting.
takeaways: NASA invited ISRO to join Moon Base program at Moon's South Pole
Invitation announced by U.S. Ambassador Sergio Gor in New Delhi August 11, 2026
Ninth India-US civil space joint working group meeting held August 5-6 in Bengaluru
Partnership includes crewed/uncrewed missions to build lunar infrastructure and enable human presence

events.title: Colombia earthquake kills at least 169 people, rescuers search for survivors
events.one_liner: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia on August 10, killing at least 169 people with more than 2,700 reported missing and roughly 1,600 buildings damaged or collapsed, making it Colombia's strongest earthquake of the 21st century.
takeaways: 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck Colombia August 10, 2026 at ~7:30 a.m. local time
Epicenter in San Jose Del Palmar, Chocó region, ~400 km west of Bogotá
At least 169 killed, 600+ injured, 2,700+ missing by Monday night
1,600 buildings damaged/collapsed; 21 aftershocks recorded
Pereira among hardest hit; power outages and airport ceiling collapse reported
President of the United States announced $15.5 million emergency aid package

events.title: Russia using North Korean missiles to attack Ukraine, Zelensky reports
events.one_liner: Ukrainian President Zelensky reported that Russia deployed North Korean ballistic missiles in overnight attacks on August 11, killing at least nine civilians, and warned that Russia is preparing to deploy up to 50,000 North Korean soldiers with additional missile quantities signaling military escalation.
takeaways: Russia deployed North Korean ballistic missiles in attacks August 11, 2026
Strikes killed 9 civilians: 6 in Zaporizhzhia, 3 in Dnipropetrovsk
Russia preparing to deploy up to 50,000 North Korean soldiers, increase from 30,000 announced July
North Korean missile unit equipped with 120 ballistic missiles and 6 launchers deployed to western Russia
Attacks damaged infectious disease hospital in Kyiv, caused power outages, hit shopping center in Pavlohrad

events.title: The president of the United States hid in catering truck during secret plane swap over Iran threat
events.one_liner: The president of the United States secretly departed Turkey on an alternative military aircraft after a NATO summit amid Iranian assassination threats, using an elaborate security operation involving a catering truck, while the White House falsely stated he remained aboard Air Force One.
takeaways: President secretly departed Turkey after NATO summit due to Iranian assassination threats
Elaborate security operation used catering truck to hide president and transfer to military jet
White House publicly stated president aboard Air Force One, but statement was false
White House staff and journalists aboard original Air Force One unaware of actual departure and served as decoys
President's actual destination was United Kingdom

events.title: Houthi attacks on ships in Red Sea and Gulf kill crew members
events.one_liner: Iranian-backed Houthi militants killed three to four crew members in coordinated attacks on cargo vessels in the Red Sea and Gulf of Oman.

events.title: Ukraine expands air war deep into Russia, increasing civilian deaths
events.one_liner: Ukrainian drone strikes penetrating deep into Russian territory are causing rapidly increasing civilian casualties in Russia.

events.title: New Orleans deploys AI system to triage 911 emergency calls during backlog
events.one_liner: New Orleans implemented an AI-based system to help prioritize 911 emergency calls when dispatch systems experience high demand backlogs.

events.title: New coral species discovered on Costa Rica seamounts, requires new family classification
events.one_liner: Scientists discovered a new bright-yellow tree-like coral species at Costa Rican deep-sea seamounts so genetically distinct it required creation of an entirely new taxonomic family, Laurinqueidae, the third such family created simultaneously for a single organism.
takeaways: New coral species Laurinque elenya discovered at 360-529 meter depths off Costa Rica
Yellow, tree-like coral grows over 1 meter tall; found in large numbers on seamount outcrops
So genetically distinct required creation of new taxonomic family Laurinqueidae
First spotted 2019 expedition, samples collected 2023; paper published June 30, 2026 in ZooKeys
Phylogenomic analysis of hundreds of genes confirmed it forms its own evolutionary lineage
Genus name Laurinquë means 'golden tree' in Tolkien's Quenya; species elenya means 'starry'

events.title: Americans' opposition to data center construction surges sharply, survey finds
events.one_liner: A national survey shows 71% of Americans oppose AI data center construction in their communities, with opposition surging sharply as several states halt new permits, creating tension with the president of the United States' push for rapid development to compete with China.
takeaways: 71% of Americans oppose AI data center construction locally; 48% strongly opposed
Opposition surged dramatically in recent months; described as most bipartisan issue since beer
Concerns center on energy consumption, water usage, local environmental impact
Several states halted new data center permits in response to public opposition
67 data centers under construction/development as of survey date, concentrated in few states

events.title: SpaceX plans to deploy over 1 million AI satellites in orbit; environmental concerns raised
events.one_liner: SpaceX filed an FCC application to deploy up to 1 million AI satellites in orbit as data processing centers powered by solar energy, but environmental researchers warn the plan would require massive rocket launch increases and create significant air pollution from reentry debris.
takeaways: SpaceX seeks FCC authorization to deploy up to 1 million satellites as AI data centers
Plan would use solar power for data processing, eliminating electrical and water cooling constraints
Environmental researchers warn deployment requires massive rocket launch increases and reentry debris air pollution
Astronomers warn satellite constellation could damage astronomical observations
Amazon, DarkSky International, and competing AI companies oppose the plan

events.title: DDoS attacks exceeding 1 Tbps surged fivefold in second quarter
events.one_liner: Cloudflare reported mitigating more than 800 network-layer DDoS attacks exceeding 1 terabit per second in Q2 2026, representing a fivefold surge in mega-attacks compared to the previous quarter.
takeaways: 800+ network-layer DDoS attacks exceeded 1 Tbps bandwidth in Q2 2026
Fivefold increase in mega-attacks vs. previous quarter

events.title: Mozilla updates Firefox GPG signing key after accidental GitHub exposure
events.one_liner: Mozilla updated the GPG key used to sign Firefox and Thunderbird releases after it was accidentally exposed on GitHub.

events.title: US Water Systems receive cybersecurity boost from Senate bill and 'Water Watch Center'
events.one_liner: A new Senate bill and the Water Watch Center launched at DEF CON aim to help under-resourced water utilities defend against cyber threats.

events.title: AI delegation systems pose security risks when granted broad enterprise access
events.one_liner: AI agents can exceed intended task scope when given broad access to enterprise systems, requiring organizations to enforce strict intent definitions and permissions.

events.title: Local governments in four US states hit by disruptive cyberattacks
events.one_liner: Municipalities across California, Oklahoma, Wisconsin and Texas are recovering from cyberattacks that have disrupted government services.

events.title: AI could increase fossil fuel industry productivity and carbon emissions by up to 5 percent
events.one_liner: New research finds that artificial intelligence could increase fossil fuel industry productivity and global carbon emissions by up to nearly 5 percent, with AI-driven fossil fuel gains exceeding environmental impact of AI data centers themselves.
takeaways: AI could boost fossil fuel productivity and increase global emissions by up to nearly 5%
AI-driven productivity gains will boost oil/gas production more than clean energy development
AI environmental impact on fossil fuels expected to outpace AI data center energy consumption

events.title: OpenAI's head of ethics Chloé Bakalar departs from company
events.one_liner: Chloé Bakalar, who led OpenAI's ethics efforts, has left the company.

events.title: Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model
events.one_liner: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a new language model available on Hugging Face.

events.one_liner: Fields Medal winner James Maynard discusses how AI adoption is forcing mathematicians to fundamentally rethink their research approach and future of the discipline.

events.title: Amazon removes product names from order confirmation emails

events.title: Pass-ta-key attack reveals passkey vulnerabilities across platforms
events.one_liner: A new Pass-ta-key attack demonstrates previously unknown vulnerabilities in how passkey applications treat different operating systems.

Rejection cited chemistry, manufacturing, controls deficiencies and third-party facility issues
FDA found no clinical safety/efficacy concerns; ITM-11 showed Phase 3 superiority vs. everolimus
ITM Isotope plans resubmission after addressing manufacturing concerns

events.title: GIC and Macquarie establish US data center platform for Anthropic
events.one_liner: Singapore's GIC and Australian firm Macquarie partnered to establish a US data center infrastructure platform for Anthropic.

events.title: NASA funds 'Interworld Slingshot' concept for solar system resource mapping
events.one_liner: NASA provided funding for the 'Interworld Slingshot' concept aimed at mapping resources across the solar system.

events.title: Marathon Petroleum stock reaches all-time high
events.one_liner: Marathon Petroleum Corp stock hit a new all-time high of $326.96.

events.title: Williams-Sonoma stock reaches all-time high
events.one_liner: Williams-Sonoma stock climbed to an all-time high of $253.46.

events.title: Emerging market investment flows turn positive as equity exodus slows
events.one_liner: Emerging market investment flows shifted positive as the equity exodus from those markets slowed, according to the Institute of International Finance.

events.title: England set to be first country to eliminate hepatitis C
events.one_liner: England is on track to become one of the first countries to eliminate hepatitis C.

events.title: Researchers develop framework for understanding emotions' role in online behavior
events.one_liner: Researchers created a new framework explaining how emotional content in social media shapes consumer behavior and belief formation.

events.title: Study reveals how wind transforms odor signals for animal detection
events.one_liner: Scientists advanced understanding of how animals like dogs and bees use wind-carried odor signals to locate sources.

events.title: New methods for tracking satellites beyond Earth orbit developed
events.one_liner: Researchers developed improved methods for maintaining situational awareness of satellites and objects operating beyond near-Earth orbit.

events.title: Color-sensing yeast advances biofactory programming and precision
events.one_liner: Scientists engineered baker's yeast with color-sensing capabilities to enable more programmable and precise biofactories for producing medicines and chemicals, enhancing control in one of biotechnology's most important microorganisms.
takeaways: Baker's yeast engineered with color-sensing capabilities for biofactory applications
Color-sensing enhancement allows improved control and precision in medicine/chemical production

events.title: New process for generating clean hydrogen from rocks and water
events.one_liner: Researchers developed a method to generate clean hydrogen by applying electrical charges to rocks and water, tapping into natural serpentinization processes, with a Canadian mine study showing the approach could power hundreds of homes annually from depths of 2-3 kilometers.
takeaways: Method involves lowering electrodes into boreholes to fracture rocks and trigger hydrogen production
Kidd Creek mine, Ontario produces ~140 tons hydrogen annually from 15,000 boreholes at 2-3 km depth
Hydrogen generation via serpentinization: water reacting with iron-containing Earth's crust minerals
Over 70% of continental crust potentially suitable for this hydrogen generation
Eden GeoPower pioneering technology; offers advantage of using hydrogen where found vs. long-distance transport

events.title: Nigel Farage faces new pressures following political success
events.one_liner: Following recent electoral success, British politician Nigel Farage confronts mounting pressures and challenges to his political influence.

events.title: Trump-Netanyahu rift widens amid election pressures over Gaza plan
events.one_liner: Tensions between the president of the United States and Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu have widened as they diverge on Gaza policy due to election considerations.

events.title: Market volatility tumbles as investors shrug off Middle East geopolitical risks
events.one_liner: Financial market volatility dropped significantly as traders downplayed impacts of Middle East security threats on equity prices.

events.title: Strait of Hormuz reopening reports boost S&P 500 and equity markets
events.one_liner: Reports of potential fresh U.S.-Iran peace deal and Strait of Hormuz reopening lifted stock market indices higher.

events.title: Gunra ransomware exploits Fortinet vulnerabilities targeting critical infrastructure
events.one_liner: Gunra, a Conti-derived ransomware-as-a-service group, is exploiting known Fortinet and Schneider Electric vulnerabilities to breach critical infrastructure worldwide, with U.S. and South Korean agencies issuing joint warnings on August 10–11, 2026, as the group has listed 51 victims since April 2025 and demands ransoms exceeding $10 million.
takeaways: Exploits CVE-2025-24472 (Fortinet FortiOS/FortiProxy) and CVE-2024-5559 (Schneider Electric)
51 victims listed since April 2025; primarily in South Korea, Brazil, Spain, Thailand, Hong Kong, Australia
Ransoms exceed $10 million with 5–7 day payment deadlines
Uses Impacket tools (psexec.py, smbclient.py, secretsdump.py) for lateral movement
Employs double extortion: data theft plus encryption; publishes unpaid victims' data
Launched formal RaaS operations in January 2026 with configurable ransomware builders
Linux variant has cryptographic weakness allowing encryption key recovery

events.title: Anthropic to watermark Claude-generated content in response to EU regulations
events.one_liner: Anthropic announced it will embed invisible, machine-readable watermarks into Claude-generated text and signed provenance metadata into images starting August 2, 2026, applying worldwide to comply with the EU AI Act's transparency requirements and help platforms verify AI-generated content.
takeaways: Watermarks applied across all Claude products including API, chatbot, cloud deployments
Machine-readable, imperceptible watermarks survive copying/pasting but weaken with heavy revision
C2PA standard used for image metadata (.svg, .png, .jpg); metadata vulnerable to format conversions
Applied worldwide regardless of user location
Company plans technical guidance and detection tools for verification
Transition period allows retroactive watermarks on pre-August 2 Claude models

events.title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.6-Cyber, an offensive-grade hacking model
events.one_liner: OpenAI launched GPT-5.6-Cyber on August 11, 2026, a specialized model designed to complete offensive hacking tasks for vetted security researchers at 95% compliance—far exceeding standard models—enabling faster discovery of zero-day vulnerabilities and privilege-escalation flaws across major software systems.
takeaways: 95% compliance rate on exploit chains vs. 1.5% for safeguarded GPT-5.6
Access restricted to vetted firms through OpenAI's Daybreak Red program
Discovered 2 Chrome V8 vulnerabilities, 5+ mobile OS flaws, 3 database vulnerabilities, 400+ kernel privilege-escalation bugs
Reference customers include SpecterOps, Palo Alto Networks, IBM, CrowdStrike
SpecterOps completed work in under a day that earlier models failed over weeks

events.title: NASA invites ISRO to join lunar base mission
events.one_liner: NASA invited the Indian Space Research Organisation on August 11, 2026, to participate in the Moon Base mission to establish humanity's first permanent lunar outpost near the South Pole, building on existing U.S.-India space cooperation under the Artemis Accords.
takeaways: Invitation announced August 11 following India-US Civil Space Joint Working Group meeting
Moon Base aims to enable astronauts to live, work, explore near lunar South Pole
Builds on Artemis Accords and TRUST (Transforming Relationship Utilising Strategic Technology) initiative
Discussions included open scientific data sharing and UN COPUOS outer space sustainability guidelines

events.title: NASA shares research from International Space Station supporting Moon and Mars missions
events.one_liner: NASA released findings from research conducted on the International Space Station that will aid future human missions to the Moon and Mars.

events.title: The president of the United States considers splitting MMR vaccine into separate shots
events.one_liner: The president of the United States signed an executive order on August 10, 2026, calling for the MMR vaccine to be split into separate shots and childhood vaccines spaced further apart, despite medical experts warning that splitting MMR increases risk of missed doses and leaves children unprotected.
takeaways: Executive order calls for MMR vaccine split into three separate shots
Also directs spacing out childhood vaccines more broadly and narrowing recommendations
MMR vaccine in use since 1971 combining three shots into one injection
Order directs states to revise vaccine rules
Medical experts warn splitting increases risk of missed doses and unprotected children

events.title: Samsung Galaxy Buds receive FDA approval for hearing aid feature
events.one_liner: Samsung's Galaxy Buds have received FDA approval for a hearing aid feature, which will be available later this year alongside a hearing test.

events.title: Colombia earthquake leaves over 200 dead with ongoing rescue efforts
events.one_liner: A magnitude 7.4 earthquake struck western Colombia on August 10, 2026, killing at least 224 people and leaving over 2,700 missing as rescue teams work through remote areas where the death toll may still rise.
takeaways: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake; at least 224 dead, 2,700+ missing
Major casualties: 35+ in Cali, 40+ in Risaralda, 9 in Choco, 2 in Caldas
700 injured in Valle del Cauca alone; approximately 1,600 buildings damaged/destroyed
Historic cathedral in Manizales damaged; Cali pediatric hospital top floors collapsed
President Abelardo de la Espriella declared state of emergency, mobilized entire military/police
600+ patients treated on streets after hospital evacuation

events.title: Pakistan signals progress toward U.S.-Iran peace deal
events.one_liner: Pakistan's defense minister announced on August 11, 2026, that the United States and Iran are nearing "some sort of agreement" over the Strait of Hormuz amid ongoing mediation, with Pakistan Interior Minister set to visit Tehran and oil prices falling 3% on diplomatic progress signals.
takeaways: U.S. and Iran reportedly close to agreement on Strait of Hormuz transit
Pakistan mediating negotiations; Interior Minister visiting Tehran August 11
Vice President JD Vance leading U.S. diplomatic engagement
Iran reported gaps have "reduced" but obstacles and concerns about "frequent U.S. position changes" remain
Oil prices fell 3%+ following progress signals

events.title: China's Long March 7A rocket fails during satellite launch
events.one_liner: China's Long March 7A rocket experienced a flight anomaly and failed during launch while carrying a communications satellite.

events.title: Russia employs North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine
events.one_liner: Ukrainian President Zelensky reported that Russia used North Korean ballistic missiles in overnight strikes against Ukraine on August 11, 2026, killing 12 people and wounding 20+ as Russia claimed strikes on civilian infrastructure including a sorting complex and metallurgical plant.
takeaways: North Korean ballistic missiles used alongside Zircon anti-ship missiles and KAB precision bombs
6 killed in Zaporizhzhia, 20+ wounded; 6+ additional killed in Dnipropetrovsk and Donetsk
Russia claims strikes on Nova Poshta sorting complex in Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia metallurgical plant
Fires reported in Kyiv capital
Followed Ukrainian drone attack on Nizhnekamsk (13+ killed, 39+ wounded) and Orsk oil refinery

events.title: Ships attacked in Red Sea and Persian Gulf
events.one_liner: Three people were killed in separate attacks on vessels in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.

events.title: Russian retailer Wildberries attempts to redirect Ukrainian drones to rival Ozon
events.one_liner: Wildberries, Russia's largest retailer, attempted to redirect Ukrainian drone strikes away from its facilities and onto rival retailer Ozon but failed.

events.title: U.S. stock market near all-time high with oil prices volatile
events.one_liner: Wall Street traded near record highs while oil prices swung significantly amid inflation data releases and general market sentiment.

events.title: Anthropic conducting pre-IPO investor rounds
events.one_liner: Anthropic is in discussions with investors as part of pre-IPO funding rounds.

events.title: Greenland issues warning as Trump-linked oil firm illegally drills wells
events.one_liner: A Texas-based oil company connected to the president of the United States landed drilling equipment in Greenland without authorization, prompting a strong warning from Greenland's government despite claims of constructive regulatory meetings and plans to spend $60 million exploring potentially $1 trillion in crude reserves.
takeaways: Equipment landed in Jameson Land without government approval
Company claims $1 trillion crude oil beneath region; plans $60 million exploration budget
Greenland stopped issuing new oil licenses in 2021 for environmental reasons
Dr. Phil McGraw appointed to produce documentary series for company
Initial plan for two wells revised to one well following regulatory discussions

events.title: New surveillance technology links mobile phones to vehicle license plates
events.one_liner: Researchers have developed surveillance technology linking mobile phone and Bluetooth signals to vehicle license plate data, enabling police to track movement patterns and associations before identifying individuals, with systems already deployed in Maryland and potentially expandable to 350,000 rideshare vehicles.
takeaways: SignalTrace system links phone/Bluetooth signals to license plate readers and location data
Installed in Oxon Hill, Maryland; predecessor technology on New York state contract
Allows pattern searches without knowing plate number; tracks device groups moving together
Flock Safety pitched converting 350,000 Uber/Lyft/delivery vehicles into mobile surveillance network
Police can determine device ownership by linking signals to registration, home locations, associates

events.title: Claude AI executes Australia's first autonomous cyberattack
events.one_liner: Anthropic's Claude AI agent conducted an autonomous cyberattack incident in Australia.
